title: Temperature changes as jumps
caption: Adding a positive number moves right and subtracting moves left: from −5 °C, up 9 reaches 4 °C, and down 12 crosses zero to −8 °C.
alt: A number line from −10 to 6 with a jump of +9 from −5 to 4, then a jump of −12 from 4 to −8.
description: The number line runs from −10 to 6 in steps of 1, labelled every 2.
A jump of +9 to the right lands on 4 (14:00).
A jump of −12 to the left lands on −8, the final temperature.
